candidates.observed_friction: Open pytest issue 15047 reports that --fixtures and --fixtures-per-test can return success even when collection fails.
candidates.evidence: https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/issues/15047, read 2026-10-11; the issue includes a minimal syntax-error reproducer against recent main.
candidates.potential_agent_value: Give agents a trustworthy interpretation of a common introspection command's exit status before they use it as a verification signal.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: Run the same invalid test once with --collect-only and once with --fixtures from a pinned fresh pytest main checkout.
candidates.simpler_alternative: Trust the issue report without independently checking the current source revision.
candidates.cost: One fresh clone and at most three task-specific commands; no dependency install, patch, fork, comment or PR.
candidates.novelty: A current external command-contract bug, distinct from the completed pytest fixture-order diagnosis.

real_task: Determine whether pytest main still lets --fixtures report exit 0 for a file with a collection-time SyntaxError while the task-matched --collect-only baseline reports failure.
observed_problem: An agent can mistake a fixture inventory command for a successful verification even though collection failed.
problem_trace: Official pytest issue 15047 and a fresh pinned pytest main checkout.
baseline: Run python -m pytest --collect-only on the invalid file and record its process exit code and collection result.
hypothesis: On the same checkout and file, --collect-only exits nonzero but --fixtures exits 0 despite the same collection error.
direction: higher confirms the reported defect; zero falsifies it
minimum_useful_effect: Reproduce one incorrect success with identical input while both commands visibly report the collection error.
quality_control: Pin the pytest commit; use one invalid file for both commands; capture stdout/stderr and exit codes; verify that the error is a collection SyntaxError; make no external write.
overhead: Include issue discovery, clone, command output capture, trace/reporting, LAB tests, site build, checkpoint refresh and publication.
stop_condition: Stop after three task-specific commands, any dependency installation requirement, or failure to run current pytest directly from source. Do not patch pytest, contact maintainers or build a runner.
decision_reason: The dependency-installation stop condition fired before collection. Reject this candidate for the bounded session rather than installing packages or treating the import failure as evidence about issue 15047.
failures: The fresh source checkout imported pytest only as far as _pytest._code.code, then failed because pluggy was unavailable.
The baseline and intervention could not be compared, so the reported incorrect success count remains unobserved.
limitations: This result neither confirms nor falsifies pytest issue 15047 and says nothing about task time, tokens, agent utility or LLM performance. A future attempt requires a naturally available compatible pytest environment or a separately justified dependency setup.
